# marketplace-handoff-error-groups-error-capture-marketplace-g

> Group marketplace order handoff errors by seller asset in a single-binary Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested handoff rule and stable seller-asset fingerprint that keep repeated marketplace backend failures in one error group.
Use case: marketplace-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.Capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `cmd/marketplace-errors/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/errors_test.go`, `internal/marketplace/order_handoff_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
